scope: Build and unit-test evidence for the runtime-neutral epoch-aware navigation task state core.
qualification: Partial P4/D/E implementation evidence only. No ROS runtime adapter, EGO integration, PX4 bridge, or navigation flight behavior was tested.

environment.build_scope: uav_navigation only, in a fresh build/install directory; not a full workspace rebuild.

behaviors_tested: Reject goals until localization is valid TRACKING and target epoch matches.
Abort and clear the associated trajectory on epoch change, invalid localization, or ROS clock regression; same-session validity does not resume an aborted goal.
Keep the old-goal cancel/trajectory-clear event ordered before acceptance of a replacement goal.
Support explicit cancellation, stale trajectory rejection, stale pose failure, and goal timeout.
Require position and wrapped yaw tolerances to remain satisfied for the configured dwell interval before success.

verification.build_command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && colcon --log-base artifacts/runs/p4-navigation-task-core-build-20261017-01/colcon-log build --base-paths src --packages-select uav_navigation --build-base artifacts/runs/p4-navigation-task-core-build-20261017-01/build --install-base artifacts/runs/p4-navigation-task-core-build-20261017-01/install --event-handlers console_direct+
verification.build_result: 1 package finished; clean Jazzy container build/install directories.

limitations: Task events are returned by a pure Python core and are not yet published through a ROS action, service, or topic.
EGO currently ignores requested target z/yaw and has no trajectory-cancel service; no third-party source was modified in this increment.
No EGO goal replacement/cancel, target/trajectory invalidation, control bridge, PX4 response, or flight behavior was exercised.
Tolerance, dwell, and timeout values are caller-supplied; formal acceptance values remain unfrozen.
